data.title: 轻井泽惠 · 假期泳池畔的湿发展露
data.description: 无人打扰的度假酒店室内温水泳池，水波倒映着幽蓝的顶灯光芒。惠身穿一袭鲜艳的热带印花比基尼侧坐在池畔白瓷阶梯上，修长白皙的双腿浸在温热池水中。湿漉漉的亚麻色长马尾搭在雪白香肩前，她单手撩起滴水的发丝，微红着脸颊向你眨了眨眼，辣妹特有的时尚自信与私密约会的羞涩完美融合。
data.location: private after-hours resort swimming pool cabana
data.action: 湿漉漉的亚麻色长马尾搭在雪白香肩前，她单手撩起滴水的发丝，微红着脸颊向你眨了眨眼
data.lighting: cool blue underwater pool lamps combined with warm tropical perimeter lighting
data.promptProse: At a quiet hotel indoor heated pool glowing under soft warm lamps and cool water reflections, Kei sits along the tiled poolside steps with her feet in the water, lifting a wet lock of hair from her shoulder as she gives a playful wink.
data.animaCaption: Perched sideways on the white tiled steps of a quiet indoor heated pool with her legs dipped in the water, she lifts a damp strand of hair off her bare shoulder and winks flirtatiously with a rosy blush in her pink-and-white striped halter bikini.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pink-and-white striped halterneck string bikini with side-tie bottoms, water droplets glistening across her collarbone, cleavage, and bare thighs.
